# Byte-span identity vs TARGET for declared/marked using stored offsets
def span_check(recs, label):
    results = []
    for r in recs:
        b0 = r["byte_offset_start"]
        b1 = r["byte_offset_end"]
        s0 = r["source_start"]
        s1 = r["source_end"]
        info = {"seq": r["seq"], "label": label, "b0": b0, "b1": b1, "s0": s0, "s1": s1}
        if not isinstance(b0, int) or not isinstance(b1, int):
            info["OFFSET_TYPE_OK"] = False
            results.append(info)
            continue
        info["OFFSET_TYPE_OK"] = True
        if not (0 <= b0 <= b1 <= len(target)):
            info["IN_RANGE"] = False
            results.append(info)
            continue
        info["IN_RANGE"] = True
        sl_excl = target[b0:b1]
        info["SLICE_EXCL_LEN"] = len(sl_excl)
        if partition_ok:
            chunk_lines = line_bytes[s0 - 1: s1]
            join_no_final = b"\n".join(chunk_lines)
            join_with_internal_and_final = b"\n".join(chunk_lines) + b"\n"
            # file bytes from start of first line to start of line after last (exclusive of following line)
            # compute offset of line s0 and line s1+1 if exist
            def line_abs_off(n):
                # sum of nbytes of lines 1..n-1 plus (n-1) LFs
                return sum(len(line_bytes[i]) for i in range(n - 1)) + (n - 1)
            off_s0 = line_abs_off(s0)
            off_after_s1 = line_abs_off(s1) + len(line_bytes[s1 - 1])  # end of last line content
            off_after_s1_nl = off_after_s1 + 1  # include terminating LF of last line
            file_span_content = target[off_s0:off_after_s1]
            file_span_with_nl = target[off_s0:off_after_s1_nl]
            info["STORED_OFFSETS_EQ_LINE_CONTENT_SPAN"] = (b0 == off_s0 and b1 == off_after_s1)
            info["STORED_OFFSETS_EQ_LINE_SPAN_PLUS_FINAL_LF"] = (b0 == off_s0 and b1 == off_after_s1_nl)
            info["SLICE_EQ_JOIN_NO_FINAL"] = sl_excl == join_no_final
            info["SLICE_EQ_JOIN_PLUS_FINAL_LF"] = sl_excl == join_with_internal_and_final
            info["SLICE_EQ_FILE_CONTENT_SPAN"] = sl_excl == file_span_content
            info["SLICE_EQ_FILE_SPAN_PLUS_LF"] = sl_excl == file_span_with_nl
            info["IDENTITY_ANY"] = any([
                info["STORED_OFFSETS_EQ_LINE_CONTENT_SPAN"],
                info["STORED_OFFSETS_EQ_LINE_SPAN_PLUS_FINAL_LF"],
                info["SLICE_EQ_JOIN_NO_FINAL"],
                info["SLICE_EQ_JOIN_PLUS_FINAL_LF"],
                info["SLICE_EQ_FILE_CONTENT_SPAN"],
                info["SLICE_EQ_FILE_SPAN_PLUS_LF"],
            ])
        results.append(info)
    return results
